system.summary: Nomenclator: homophonic alphabet of figures and marked letters plus three-letter code groups for words and syllables (N.73 is a different, unread system).

diacritics.note: Barred and flourished forms distinguish signs (barred q, k-flourish on myk); a merged q sign may hide two values.

system.sibling_key: Deciphered siblings N.46 and N.52BIS (same key, clerk decipherments) used to rebuild it
system.notes: 153 is groups recovered, alphabet included; the real key size is unknown. key_order 'random' is from the code values in key.md, not stated in NOTES.

prior_solution.where: Terrateig, Política en Italia del Rey Católico (1963) vol. II prints Ferdinand's letters to Vich; not seen

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: PARES search 'Vich cifrada' listed the ciphered letters; images fetched.
Aligned N.46 and N.52BIS with their clerk decipherments to rebuild alphabet and common groups.
N.57 read with the rebuilt key.
N.45 read; key extended, fug/fuq and plort corrected.
N.73: Spanish 5-gram annealing with groups split, whole, and as context breaks.
Terrateig 1963 searched by snippet; dates not found, book not seen.
Clear subscriptions give place and date matching the catalogue; content fits Ravenna, the 1511 promotion, the Navarre bulls.

outcome.method: key recovered based on adjacent plaintext
outcome.method_basis: The nomenclator was rebuilt by aligning N.46 and N.52BIS, sibling letters in the same Vich file (AHN Estado 8715) that carry the clerk's decipherment on the following leaves, with their cipher; N.45, N.57 and N.60 were then read and filled in the rest.

gaps.detail: different system, no deciphered sibling (N.74 is a third system); annealing with Spanish 5-grams failed

gaps.item: unread groups in N.45, N.57, N.60 (~1,168 bracketed tokens)
gaps.detail: the decipherments of N.41 and 8714 N.12/N.26/N.39 would close most, and were never aligned
NOTES ask for a careful re-reading against the images; not done

outcome.fraction_read_source: n45_pp*.txt, n57_transcription.txt, n60_pp*.txt, n73_transcription.txt: cipher tokens with a value in decode.py LET/CODE (scratchpad measure_F_vich.py): N.45 9,699/9,959, N.57 953/988, N.60 10,739/11,612, N.73 0/3,177 (other key); unknown groups, ? and / counted unread. Key coverage overstates sense: bracket share in the decoded outputs is 95%, 94.5%, 88% (N.45/57/60)
outcome.notes: N.45, N.57, N.60 read with about 3-8% of groups unread (5-14% counting garbled stretches); N.73 not read. fraction_read measured roughly: 12,213 of 13,381 decoded tokens in N.45/N.57/N.60 not bracketed, over those plus the 3,177 tokens of unread N.73 (0.74).
